title: Review intents: start a queue, accept, reject with reason, skip, repeat, stop
description:
Intents:
- StartReviewIntent with a queue slot (best bets / needs my help) and many samples, for example 'what needs my help', 'review references', 'best bets'.
- AcceptIntent ('accept', 'yes keep it', 'approve').
- RejectIntent with an optional free-text reason slot (AMAZON.SearchQuery). A reject without a reason asks 'why?' once and maps the answer with `rejectionReasonCodeForWrittenReason`.
- SkipIntent, plus the existing repeat, help and stop.

Behaviour:
- Each reference is one short spoken part (title, subtitle, summary), then 'accept, reject, or skip?'.
- After a vote: a short confirmation, then the next reference.
- An empty queue says so and offers the other queue.

Gherkin covers every turn.
